I am here in Mwanza, my rice plot is small, just half a hectare, and the land is not even mine — I rent it. I have no schooling, so I do what my father did and what my neighbors do. Cash is tight this year and I cannot waste shillings on a full bag of fertilizer for such a small piece of land that is not mine. I will use the seed I kept from last harvest, work the plot with my wife and children, and ask a few neighbors to help me when it is time to transplant and to harvest — I will give them food and a little money.
